Admin privileges within the sandbox company to access Settings and Developer Hub.
The exact OAuth callback URL: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add.
Go to developers.pipedrive.com and submit the Developer Sandbox account registration form. Confirm your email to activat
Log in to your sandbox account, click your profile icon in the top right, select the sandbox company name, and click Dev
Click Create an app and choose Create private app (or Create public app if submitting for Marketplace listing).
In the Basic info tab, enter your App name and paste the Composio redirect URI into the Callback URL field, then click S
Navigate to the OAuth & access scopes tab and check activities:full, contacts:full, leads:full, mail:full, products:full
Copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret from the OAuth & access scopes tab to enter into Composio.
Click Save, then click the Change to live button to activate the app for external installations via direct link.
activities:full provides full read and write access to Pipedrive activities without requiring restricted scope review.
contacts:full provides full read and write access to persons and organizations without requiring restricted scope review
leads:full provides full read and write access to leads without requiring restricted scope review.
mail:full provides full read and write access to mail messages and threads without requiring restricted scope review.
products:full provides full read and write access to products without requiring restricted scope review.
projects:full provides full read and write access to projects and tasks without requiring restricted scope review.

Developer Hub is accessible only inside a Developer Sandbox account, not from standard production accounts.
Pipedrive allows only one callback URL per registered OAuth app.
Sandbox accounts are deleted if inactive for 45 days without creating an app, or 6 months without publishing an app or m
App type (public vs private) cannot be changed in Developer Hub once created; switching requires creating a new app.
Users cannot grant partial permissions; all requested scopes must be accepted together at installation.
Pipedrive OAuth access tokens expire after 60 minutes and must be refreshed regularly using refresh tokens.
